firstHost.workingTree: 4.0.0 on every pin and the Platform version matrix; the exact candidate tarball, committed at release-candidates/trdrs-quickcharts-4.0.0.tgz, installed through a temporary root pnpm override

ownerWaiver.question: Quick Charts 4.0.0's acceptance record needs your manual accessibility and advertised-browser acceptance, or an explicit waiver (as you gave for 3.0.0). Which do you want recorded?
ownerWaiver.statement: Asked by his coordinating session whether to record his manual accessibility and advertised-browser acceptance for Quick Charts 4.0.0 or an explicit waiver, Joey chose "Waive and authorize (Recommended)", the option that read: "Same as 3.0.0: I record your waiver of the manual accessibility and browser acceptance, quoted with its time. The automated conformance in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit still runs. A waiver doesn't claim screen-reader or device support."

ownerDecision.manualAcceptance: waived by owner for this release
ownerDecision.npmPublishApproval: delegated by Joey to his coordinating session, which approves the npm-publish environment once the validation job passes. Asked "When the release workflow reaches the npm-publish environment, may I approve it for you, as you had me do for 3.0.0?", he chose "Approve it for me (Recommended)", the option that read: "I approve the npm-publish environment once validation passes. Its tarball must match the accepted candidate byte for byte, which the workflow verifies."

knownIssues: The 4.0.0 notes name three constants that no public entry of 4.0.0 exports: BAR_PRICE_SOURCES (CHANGELOG.md and README.md), BARS_PATTERN_MODES (CHANGELOG.md and its Upgrading to 4.0 guide) and SERIAL_VERSION (the Upgrading to 4.0 guide). The notes also state each value they hold, so a host needs none of them. The candidate was accepted for publication as it is.
